name: GlowWire LED Strip — 2m
description: Two-meter strip of flexible LED lights with adhesive backing. Peel, stick, plug in. Available in 8 colors. The cheapest way to make a the Gray Zone dwelling feel less like a concrete box.
flavor_profile: Soft, colored glow, low power consumption, adhesive that barely holds on humid walls
cultural_context: GlowWire is everywhere in the Gray Zone. Purple, blue, red — the colored strips turn concrete corridors into something approaching home. They're cheap enough for anyone, and the cumulative effect of a the Gray Zone block where everyone has GlowWire is actually beautiful. It's accidental collaborative art.
story_hooks: The colored glow of GlowWire-lit the Gray Zone corridors has become iconic imagery of lower-tier life — photographers and filmmakers romanticize it, which residents find both flattering and insulting.
related_entities: Novafold Pharmaceuticals GraftSkin TS-7 Bioprinted Dermal Replacement Sheet
